notas_originais: Pl. טָעֲמַיָּא. Esth. R. to I, 3 בני ט' ובני סגניא דיליה his young pleaders and counselors. Ib. בני ט' בני … דיליה pleaders means his counsellors.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (cmp. טָעָה) [ procurar, perguntar, (cmp. בְּעָא),]; reclamar perante o tribunal, processar, pleitear.; procurar, suspeitar, v. infra.; ser processado, ser réu, réu.
definicoes_originais: to claim before court, to sue, to plead.
to seek after, to suspect, v. infra.
to be sued, to be respondent, defendant.
to be inquired after, suspected, to be summoned on suspicion.
notas_originais: Keth. XIII, 4 הטוֹעֵן את חבירו כדי וכ' if one claims from his neighbor a certain number of jugs of oil. Ib. 108 b, a. e. טְעָנוֹ חטין וכ' if one claims wheat and barley (two different things), and defendant admits barley. Shebu. 43 a עד שיִטְעֲנֶנּוּ בדבר וכ' until he sues him for something weighable or countable. Gitt. 58 b טוֹעֲנִין ליורש וכ' the court pleads in behalf of the heir &c.; a. v. fr.—Part. pass. טָעוּן, f. טְעוּנָה is required for, requires. Zeb. V, 7 דמן ט' הזייה their blood is required for sprinkling (must be sprinkled). Bicc. II, 1 טְעוּנִים רחיצת וכ' require washing of hands; a. v. fr.—Denom. טֹעַן, טוֹעַן requirement, obligation, fr. which טָ' טֹעַן to require. Sifra introd. ויצא מן הכלל לִיטְעוֹן ט' אחר שהוא וכ' and is specified for another requirement in keeping with the general subject.

Y. B. Kam. X, beg. 7 b אפי' קטנים נִטְעָנִין להן בב"ד even for minors defense is made in court (prob. to be read: טוֹעֲנִין, cmp. Gitt. 58 b, quoted supra). [In later literature טוֹעֵן claimant, נִטְעָן defendant.]

Yeb. II, 8 הנ' על א"א וכ' if one was suspected of intercourse with a married woman, and the court caused her to be sent away from him (her husband) on his account; ib. 24 b; Tosef. ib. IV, 5 הניט' מא"א. Y. ib. II, 4 a bot. בנ' בעדים when the suspicion has been corroborated by witnesses.
Keth. 105 b אי בעי טָעֵין וכ' if he chooses, he may plead thus. Gitt. 58 b אי דקא טעין וכ' is it that he pleads (demurs) and says &c.?; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: , uma. Gés. H. Ditado. 10 seg. v. צען) [ mover-se, preparar-se para viajar,]; (cmp. נָשָׂא) carregar, embalar.; estar carregado.; para ser carregado.
definicoes_originais: , a. Ges. H. Dict. 10 s. v. צען) [ to move, make ready for travelling,]
notas_originais: Num. R. s. 6 וטוֹעֲנִים על העגלות and pack (them) upon wagons; a. fr.—Part. pass. טָעוּן (interch. with טוֹעֵן) laden, carrying. Ib. s. 5 מי שהוא ט' בקרשים some had a share in carrying (moving) the boards. Ib. טוענין כל כלי האריגה had to carry all woven materials. Ib. s. 6 היה מִטּוֹעֲנֵי וכ' was one of those carrying the ark. B. Mets. 32 b טְעוּנָה יין אסור carrying forbidden wine.—Midr. Till. to Ps. XVIII בשעה … טְעוּנִין את המים when the clouds are charged with water; Yalk. Sam. 160 טוענין מן המים (corr. acc.), v. חָשַׁךְ. Ib. אלו טוענין חרבות וכ' those carrying swords, others lances &c.; a. fr.—3) Esp. to help one broken down on the road to load again, contrad. to פרק to help in unloading. B. Mets. II, 10 מצוה לִטְעוֹן … the biblical law requires man to help in unloading, but not in loading (without remuneration); אף לט' loading, too, must be done gratuitously, v. טְעִינָה; a. fr.
Gen. R. s. 82 נ' ברכות was laden with blessings; a. e.—Trnsf. (cmp. כָּבֵד) to be very ill. Treat. S’maḥ. ch. VIII אמר לו נ' he said to him, He (thy son) is very ill.
Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXXVII [read:) אינן יכולין להִטָּעֵן … וטוֹעֲנִין וכ' who cannot be carried (on wagons &c.) … and they carry them on their hands (in a chair); (v. next w. a. Yalk. Ps. 838).

Lev. R. s. 13 ה' לחמורו וכ' he put on his ass five S’ah &c. Sabb. 5 a הִטְעִינוֹ חבירו his neighbor placed something in his hand to carry, ה' שמים the heavens placed &c. (when he put his hand forth to collect and carry rain water); a. e.
Y. Peah I, 16 a top (ref. to Lev. XIX, 16) שלא תהא כרוכל הזה מַטְעִין דבריו וכ' be not like the peddler carrying the talk of this one to the other &c.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ,; estar carregado; carregar, carregar (h. נשא).; carregar, aproveitar.; mesmo.
definicoes_originais: to be laden; to carry, bear (h. נשא).
(v. preced. Nif.) to become severely ill.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. II Num. XIII, 23 (ed. Amst. טַעֲנוּ Pa.). Targ. O. Gen. XLIV, 1. Targ. Joel II, 22; a. fr.—B. Mets. 40 b כיון דטָעוּן טָעוּן when they are once impregnated (with the fluid), they resorb no more.—Trnsf. to suffer, bear. Targ. Prov. IX, 12; a. e.

Targ. O. Gen. XLV, 17 טְעוּנוּ ed. Berl. (oth ed. a. Y. טְעִינוּ). Targ. Y. ib. XLIV, 13.—Esp. to help carrying, opp. פרק, v. preced. Gen. R. s. 96 משל הדיוט … טעון וכ' the common adage says, if thy friend’s son is dead, help carrying; if thy friend is dead, throw off (common people show no favor where no return can be expected). Y. Ḥag. II, 77 b top מִיטְעוֹן תרי וכ' that two carry one load; a. fr.

Ib. הוון מְטַעֲנִין להין they made them carry &c.—Part. pass. מְטַעַן carried, moved. Cant. R. to IV, 8 דלית אינון … מְטַעֲנִין וכ' who are too feeble to be carried in a lectica, and whom they carry in a cathedra

Ib. מַטְעִינִין. Y. Ḥag. l. c. אַטְעוּנְנוֹן יחידאין carry them singly, אַטְעוֹנִינוֹן וכ' they did so; אטעונינון צלוחיין carry straight through (without resting).—א' חינא = h. נשא חן to find grace. Targ. Esth. II, 17 (ed. Lag. אִיטְּ', Ithpe.); a. e.
. Targ. Lam. V, 5. Targ. Esth. l. c., v. supra.
Y. Bets. I, 60 c bot. מִיטְּעַן מערס וכ' allowed himself to be carried from one seat (where he lectured) to another. Ib., v. סְדִינָא.
Targ. II Sam. XII, 15 (h. text ויאנש).

verbetes.glosa_atual: mover-se para frente e para trás, balançar um chicote etc. Núm. R.s. 12 ??? balançado, atingido por uma lança etc., ferido.
definicoes_originais: to move to and back, to swing a whip &c. Num. R. s. 12 דלא יהוון טַעֲנִין וכ' that they should not swing the rod over the children (Midr. Till. to Ps. XCI … מחון; Yalk. Ps. 842 מחיין).
swung upon, struck with a spear &c., wounded.
notas_originais: Targ. Is. XIV, 19 מְטַעֲנֵי חרב (h. text מְטֹעֲנֵי). Targ. Jer. XXXVII, 10 מְטַעֲנִין (h. text מדקרים); a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (טָעַן I); exigência, v. טָעַן I.; pesquisar, reivindicar.
definicoes_originais: requirement, v. טוֹעַן a. טָעַן I.
notas_originais: I.
B. Mets. 28 b אבן ט', v. טָעָה.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (טָעַן I); apelo, ação, reclamação.; suspeita, conversa, descoberta de falhas.
notas_originais: Shebu. VI, 1 הט' … וההודאה וכ' if the claim is for two M’ah silver, and the defendant admits the value of a P’rutah. Ib. אם אין ההודאה ממין הט' if the defendant’s admission is not homogeneous with the claim (e.g. one sues for wheat and the defendant alleges to owe barley). Ib. 39 b כפירת ט' שתי וכ' the claim of two M’ah in the Mishnah means that amount of the claim which is disputed; ט' עצמה וכ' it means that the original claim was for two &c. Keth. I, 1 טַעֲנַת בתולים, v. בְּתוּלִים.—B. Kam. 57 a ט' גנב, v. גַּנָּב. Ib. ט' לסטים, v. לִסְטֵיס; a. fr.— Pl. טַעֲנוֹת. Y. Snh. III, 21 b bot. צריך … לשנות טַעֲנוֹתֵיהֶן the judge must repeat the pleas of the contesting parties; Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXII לשקול ט'; Yalk. Kings 175 לשקול ט' בפני שניהם weigh their pleas in the presence of both parties; a. e.

Num. R. s. 10 (ed. Amst. p. 240 a) מפני טענת הבריות not to give rise to people’s talk; Ab. d’R. N. ch. II. Y. Ber. I, 3 c מפני ט' המינין not to give support to the talk of the heretics (Bab. ib. 12 a תרעומת).
Kidd. 28 a האי ט' מעליית' היא is not this a good plea?— Pl. טַעֲנָתָא. Keth. 18 a כולהי ט' טענת וכ' all pleas consist of the claim of other people and one’s own admission (replique).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (עוק, ט para ת; cmp. טִיגָּן) ser estreito.; ser pressionado, perturbado.
definicoes_originais: (עוק, ט for ת; cmp. טִיגָּן) to be narrow.
notas_originais: Targ. Prov. IV, 12 תִּטְעוּק ed. Lag. (Levita תִּטְעַק; ed. Wil. תתעוק).
Targ. Ps. XXXI, 10 אִיטָּעַק Ms. (ed. אִיטְּעַק, ed. Wil. אִתְּעָק; ed. Lag. איטלק). Targ. Prov. XXIV, 10 מִתְטָעִיק Ms. a. Lev. (ed. Lag. a. oth. מתתעיק). V. תְּעַק.

pl. (b. h.; טָפַף I; cmp. טפל) [ joined to, dependent,] children. Ḥag. 3 a (ref. to Deut. XXXI, 12) טף למה באין why must the children come?; Tosef. Sot. VII, 9 טף למה בא (Var. טְפֵלִין … באין); Ab. d’R. N. ch. XVIII. Mekh. Bo. s. 16 וכי טף היה יודע וכ' would children have known to distinguish &c.?
, v. טְפֵי
, v. sub טִיפּ'.
, Y. Ber. I, 2 c bot., read: נוֹפוֹ, v. נוֹף II.—Targ. Cant. II, 8, v. טְפַז.
, v. טִיפּוּח
, v. טָפַח II a. טְפִיחַ II
— Pl. טְפוּחִין. Targ. Y. Gen. XXVII, 30 כתרתין ט' about the time needed for two raps.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. precedido.) aldrava, aquele que batendo na parede descobre tesouros escondidos.
definicoes_originais: (v. preced.) knocker, one who by rapping at the wall discovers hidden treasures.
notas_originais: — Pl. טְפוֹחָאֵי. B. Mets. 42 a; cmp. גָּשׁוֹשָׁא.
, v. טַפִּיטָא

verbetes.glosa_atual: tippuyin, nome de certos pequenos insetos.
definicoes_originais: tippuyin, name of certain small insects.
notas_originais: Sabb. 107 b הט' Ms. M. a. Rashi (ed. טִפּוּיֵי; Ms. O. טִיפּוּיִין); cmp. טִיפָּה.

Kel. XVI, 7 ט' של תפלה the block on which the case of the phylacteries is shaped. Y. Snh. X, 28 d top ט' של פעור a cast of the idol P’or; (Sifré Num. 131 דפיס; Snh. 106 a יראתה). Y. Sabb. IV, 8 b bot. ט' של דדים, v. דָּפוּס. Dem. V, 4 (ed. Y. טִיפּוּס). Y. ib. 24 d top נחתום עושה ט' אחד if the baker makes only one form of loaves. Ib. (once) טופוס אחד (corr. acc.); a. e.— Pt. טְפוּסִין. Dem. V, 3 (Ar. דפ'). Y. ib. l. c. נחתום … כמה ט' if the baker makes several forms of loaves. Ib. שני טפסין (corr. acc.).—Cant. R. to VI, 4 טִיפּוּסִים של פעור, v. supra.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (correspondente a h. קפץ) [ aderir, contratar,]; fechar.; pular.
definicoes_originais: (corresp. to h. קפץ) [ to join, contract,]
notas_originais: Targ. Job V, 16 טָפְזַת ed. Lag. (some ed. טַפְּיַת).
Targ. Y. Num. XXI, 35.—Targ. Cant. II, 8 וט' על קיצא (ed. Lag. וטפו, ed. Vien. וטפן, corr. acc.) leaped over (redeemed them before) the destined end of the captivity. Targ. Ps. LXVIII, 17; a. fr.
same. Ib. CXIV, 6 דאתון מְטַפְּזִין Ms. (ed. טפזו incorr.). Targ. Job XXI, 11; a. fr.—V. טְפֵי IV

Targ. O. Lev. XI, 5 (ed. Berl. טַבְ', v. Berl. Massor. p. 86; Y. טַוְו'); Targ. Deut. XIV, 7. Gen. R. s. 12 הדין ט' מיגין וכ' the rabbit seeks protection under a projecting rock from the bird of prey &c.; Yalk. Ps. 862. — Pl. טַפְזַיָּא. Targ. Ps. CIV, 18.

verbetes.glosa_atual: [juntar-se estreitamente, de onde טֶפַח (cmp. קוֹמֶץ) juntou os dedos, na largura da mão,] para entrar em contato próximo; (cmp. נָקַשׁ) golpear, bater.; bater com a mão espalmada, dar um tapa.; bater palmas em um determinado tom de alegria ou luto, v. טִיפּוּחַ.; coletar o conteúdo de um recipiente quebrado com a palma da mão, limpar com a palma da mão.
definicoes_originais: [ to join closely, whence טֶפַח (cmp. קוֹמֶץ) joined fingers, hand-breadth,] to come in close contact; (cmp. נָקַשׁ) to strike, knock.
to strike with the flat hand, to slap.
to clap hands to a certain tune in rejoicing or mourning, v. טִיפּוּחַ.
to collect the contents of a broken vessel by palming, to wipe with the palm.
notas_originais: B. Kam. 32 b נתזה בקעת וטָפְחָה לו על פניו Ms. M. a chip flew off and struck him in the face. Ib. נתזו … וטָפְחוּ לו וכ' Ms. M. sparks flew off and hit him &c.; a. fr.—Esp. (denom. of טֶפַח) טָפַח, a.

Gen. R. s. 22, end התחיל אדה"ר מְטַפֵּחַ על פניו Adam slapped his own face; Lev. R. s. 10 טוֹפֵחַ. Kidd. 31 a טָפְחָה לו על ראשו slapped him on his head. Gen. R. s. 45 טְפָחַתָּהּ וכ' (Yalk. ib. 79 קפחתה) she slapped her face with her shoe. Y. Kil. VIII, 31 c top טי' כנגד וכ' (Kidd. 24 b הכהו) if he struck him over his eye and blinded him. Ab. Zar. IV, 10 היה מְטַפֵּחַ על וכ' (Bab. ed. 60 b מַטְפִּיחַ, Y. ed. מתפח) he slapped upon the fermenting barrel (to check fermentation). Toh. III, 8 שדרך התינוק לטַפֵּחַ a child likes to slap (dough &c., to dabble); a. e.

Bets. V, 2 לא מְטַפְּחִין וכ' we must not clap hands, or strike upon the knees, or stamp on the Holy Day. M. Kat. III, 8 מענות אבל לא מְטַפְּחוֹת may sing the dirge but must not clap. Ib. 9. Num. R. s. 4 … שהיה מקיש וטוֹפַחַ he knocked his hands against each other and clapped; ib. וטפח. Cant. R. to II, 14 מְטַפַּחַת באגפיה clapped her wings.
Ter. XI, 7. Sabb. 143 b ולא יְטַפֵּחַ בשמן must not use the palm for collecting oil in the broken vessel.
same. Ab. Zar. 60 b, v. supra.

verbetes.glosa_atual: , Pa.; fechar com cuidado.; dar um tapa, bater com a mão, bater com o pé.; bater palmas.
definicoes_originais: to slap, strike with hand, stamp with foot.
notas_originais: טַפֵּחַ ch. same,
B. Kam. 23 a לא ט' באפיה (Ms. H. טפא, v. טְפֵי IV) he did not carefully close (the stable) before him.

Targ. II Kings XIX, 24; Is. XXXVII, 25. Targ. Ez. XXI, 17; 19; a. fr.—Targ. Jon. IV, 8 ט' שמשא וכ' the sun beat upon &c.—B. Kam. 32 b ט' ליה רבא בסנדליה Raba struck him upon his (R. Shimi’s) sandal (to silence him); M. Kat. 25 a; B. Bath. 22 a; a. e.
Y. Snh. II, beg. 19 d; Y. Hor. III, beg. 47 a שרי ט' בחדא וכ' he made the motion of clapping with one hand; ובחדא טַפְחִין do people clap with one hand?; a. e.
Targ. Ps. CXLI, 5; Targ. Is. XLI, 7 (h. text הלם).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (cmp. טָפַף II) pingar, ficar úmido.; umedecer, molhar.
definicoes_originais: (cmp. טָפַף II) to drip, be moist.
notas_originais: Sabb. 17 a עדיין משקה טוֹפֵחַ וכ' moisture is still dripping on them. Yoma 78 a טוֹפֵחַ ע"מ להַטְפִּיחַ moist enough to moisten other objects; Ab. Zar. 60 b טופח ע"מ להטפיח Ms. M. (ed. ט' להט'). Toh. VIII, 9; a. fr.—2) (cmp. דאב, דוי) to melt, decay, ferment (of a running and fermenting dough). B. Mets. 59 b אף בצק … ט' (Ms. R. 2 תפח, v. תָּפַח) even the dough under the hands of the kneading women fermented.—Y. Yeb. XII, end, 13 a וטפח רוחי עלי; Yalk. Prov. 964 טָפְחָה וכ' my mind in me became fermenting, i.e. I felt proud (v. טוּף).— Part. pass. טָפוּחַ decaying, languishing (from starvation). Sifra B’ḥuck. Par. 2, ch. VI טְפוּחֵי רעב (v. תָּפַח).
Yoma 78 a טינא מַטְפַּחַת clay which makes wet (those sitting on it). Ib.; Ab. Zar. 60 b להַטְפִּיחַ, v. supra. Ber. 25 a כל זמן שמַטְפִּיחִין as long as the spot is wet enough to moisten.

verbetes.glosa_atual: v. טָפַח I) largura da mão, largura de quatro dedos unidos.
definicoes_originais: v. טָפַח I) hand-breadth, breadth of four fingers joined.
notas_originais: Succ. 4 b, a. fr. ארון תשעה וכפרת ט' the Ark was nine handbreadths high, and the lid one. Ib. 7 a ט' שוחק a liberal hand-breadth (four fingers not closely joined). v. אַמָּה.—Yoma 55 a top טִיפְחָהּ של כפורת Ar. a. Ms. M. 2 a. Ms. O. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 9, ed. עוביה) the hand-breadth, i.e. the hight, of the lid, v. supra.; a. v. fr.— Pl. טְפָחִים, Du. טְפָחַיִים. Taan. 25 b; a. v. fr. [טְפָחִין, or טִפְחִין, v. טְפִיחַ II.]
, v. טַפִּיטָא
, v. טָפַף II

verbetes.glosa_atual: (cmp. טָפַח II); desmaiar, morrer, extinguir-se.; apagar, extinguir.; para ser extinto, escurecer.
definicoes_originais: to grow faint, to die out, be extinguished.
notas_originais: Targ. I Sam. III, 3. Targ. Job XVIII, 5, sq.; a. e.—Y. Sabb. I, 3 b bot. אילין בעיין דיִטְפֵי וכ' they (the children) desire that the lamp grow dim (so that they need not study, and therefore will not snuff it). Lev. R. s. 9 אשכחא בוצינא טָפֵי she found the lamp gone out; (Y. Sot. I, 16 d bot. מִיטְּפֵי Ithpe); a. e.

Targ. Cant. VIII, 7. Targ. II Sam. XXI, 17; a. e.—Y. Yoma VIII, 45 b בעי מִטְפְתָה wanted to put it out; Y. Ned. IV, 38 d מיטפייה (read: מִיטְפִינָהּ). Ib. אפי' ר' אימי יִטְפֵי (or Af.) even R. I. would have been permitted to extinguish the fire on the Sabbath.
same. Tanḥ. Vayigg. 5 נורא דתמר כלתך אנא מַטְפֵי I will put out the fire intended for Tamar &c. (I will curb thy passion; Yalk. Gen. 150 אנן מנהרין we shall light for thee).

Y. Sabb. VI, 8 c bot. [read:] איטפי בוצינא אמרה לה לא איתטפי אמרי לא מיטפי בוצינא וכ' is the light out? Said she, it is not out. Upon which they said (this means) the light of Israel is not extinguished (R. A. is not dead). Y. Sot. I, 16 d bot., v. supra. Y. Ḥag. II, 77 c top ואִיטַּפְיַית and the fire over the grave was extinguished (v. דְּמַךְ).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (= h. צָפָה, v. טוּף); flutuar.; inundar.; (denominação de טִיפָּא) cair.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. Ex. XXVI, 28 והוה טָפֵי (not והות).
Y. Snh. X, 29 a bot. ובעי מִטְפָא עלמא and wanted to inundate the world.
Targ. Job XV, 8 some ed. (v. טְפַף II).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. טָפַף eu); para juntar, adicionar, aumentar.
notas_originais: Taan. 24 a אי טָפוּ לה וכ' when they put on too much or too little. Ab. Zar. 9 a ונִיטְפֵי עלייהו וכ' and let him add thereto twenty years. Yoma 35 a אי בציר מהני וט' אהני if he makes the ones less in value and adds to the value of the others; a. fr.—Part. טָפֵי, f. טַפְיָא more. Sabb. 19 a אי ט' if it is more in measure (than before washing).—Ab. Zar. 9 b דמתניתא ט' וכ' the calculation of the Boraitha is three years more.—Adv. טְפֵי more. Gitt. 44 a, a. e., v. חַד II.—R. Hash. 26 b bot. כמה … ט' מעלי the more … the better it is. B. Bath. 144 b חריף ט' he is smarter (than his brother); a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. P. Sm. 150; = טְפַח I, para encerrar, Targ. Job V, 16 טְפִיַת (alguma ed. טַפְּיַת Pa.
definicoes_originais: = טְפַח I, to close, Targ. Job V, 16 טְפִיַת (some ed. טַפְּיַת Pa.
notas_originais: ), v. טְפַז.—B. Kam. 23 a, v. טְפַח. [Targ. Cant. II, 8, v. טְפַז.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: (= טְפִיחַ I, v. טְפֵי II) [ gotejador,] recipiente com gargalo estreito.
definicoes_originais: (= טְפִיחַ I, v. טְפֵי II) [ dripper,] vessel with a narrow neck.
notas_originais: Kel. II, 3 ט' שהתקינו לענבים a pitcher which was made with the intention of using it for grapes. Ib. III, 2. Neg. XII, 5 טָפְיוֹ (R. S. a. l. תָּפְיוֹ) man’s oil vessels.
f., v. טְפֵי III.—[טַפְיָא m., v. next w.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: (טָפַח II, v. טָפִי); jarro para tirar água para beber ou lavar as mãos.; vaso em forma de jarro colocado em paredes e cornijas como ninho de pássaro.; solo lamacento, solo onde a água baixou, opp. para גריד.
definicoes_originais: pitcher for drawing water for drinking or hand-washing.
a pitcher-shaped vessel put up in walls and cornices as bird’s nest.
muddy soil, ground on which water subsided, opp. to גריד.
notas_originais: Sabb. XVII, 6 (125 b), v. זְמוֹרָה. Ib. XXIV, 5, v. פָּקַק. B. Bath. 63 a ‘give him a share in my well לט' Ms. M. a. Rashb. (ed. לטפיחי, corr. acc.; Ms. F. לטַפְיָא, cmp. טָפִי) for the pitcher’, i.e. for drinking purposes. Tosef. Ber. IV, 11 [read as] Yoma 30 a ומחזיר הט' על האורחים (v. Rashi a. l.; Ms. M. והט' חוזר וכ') and passes the pitcher (which he had used for washing his hands) around the guests.
— Pl. טְפִיחִים, טְפִיחִין. Bets. 24 a; 25 a; Tosef. Sabb. XII (XIII), 4; ib. XVIII, 4 ed. Zuck. (Var. טפחין); ib. Bets. I, 10; Ḥull. 139 b
Gen. R. s. 33, end (Yalk. ib. 56 מקפה).

verbetes.glosa_atual: , (v. טָפַח II, 2); por favor. טְפִיחִים, טְפִיחִין grãos pobres e limitados; [outra opinião: (v. טָפַח I, a. cmp. סָפִיחַ) crescimento entre a grama].; (sub. רעב) alguém que se parece com quem sofre os efeitos da fome, preto-amarelado.
definicoes_originais: pl. טְפִיחִים, טְפִיחִין stinted, poor grains; [another opinion: (v. טָפַח I, a. cmp. סָפִיחַ) growth between grass].
(sub. רעב) one looking like those who suffer from the effects of famine, yellowish-black.
notas_originais: Shebi. IX, 4. Y. ib. 39 a top טפחין; Tosef. ib. VII, 15 רחיפין ed. Zuck. (Var. רפיחין, ספיחין). [Tosef T’bul Yom. I, 1, sq., v. טוֹפַח.]

Bekh. 45 b שחור … יצא מהן טָפוּחַ ed. (Rashi טפיח) a very dark-complected man must not marry an equally complected woman, lest their offspring may be a t’fia ḥ; [Rashi: black as a pitcher, v. טְפִיחַ I].

verbetes.glosa_atual: (טָפַח I) martelar para fins de polimento.
definicoes_originais: (טָפַח I) hammering for the purpose of polishing.
notas_originais: Tosef. Sabb. XI (XII), 2.

Lev. R. s. 30 (Ar. דיופוטא).— Pl. טַפִּיטִין. Koh. R. to III, 9 טפו' (corr. acc.) Gen. R. s. 33 saw in Rome עמודים מכוסין בט' וכ' (not בטפיסין) statues covered with rugs, in winter &c., Yalk. Ps. 727 בטיפיטין (corr. acc.); Lev. R. s. 27 בטיפטיאות (read: טַפִּיטִיאוֹת). Lam. R. to I, 16; ib. introd. (R. Joh. 2) טפטיות (read: טַפִּיטִיּוֹת).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (tapeta, acc. -tam) mesmo, ט' של סוס cavalo, habitação.
definicoes_originais: (tapeta, acc. -tam) same, ט' של סוס horsecloth, housing.
notas_originais: Kel. XXIII, 2.
, Targ. Y. Lev. XI, 35 Bxt., v. תַּפְיָא.
, v. טְפֵלָ'
Y. Keth. VIII, 32 b top כדי טְפִילָתָן as much as their sustenance costs. Y. Orl. I, 60 d top כדי טְפִילָתָהּ worth the labor given to its (the grape-vine’s) cultivation (R. S. to Orl. I, 2 נפילתה).
, v. טַפִּיטָא

— Pl. טְפִיפִיּוֹת. Bekh. 22 a מִשֶּׁיֵּרָאוּ ט' from the time travailing has reached that stage when the ringlike formations at the mouth of the vagina are visible (indicating the passage of the embryo’s head); [Ar. reads: קְפִיפִים, Var. קְפִיפִיּוֹת; Tosef. Ohol. VIII, 8 קְפִיפִים.]—Cmp. טֶפֶף.
, v. טְפַשׁ

B. Mets. 73 b ושפכו ליה טפי כופיתא (Ms. M. ושפכי כופיתא, read טפיתא; Alf. טַפְיָיתָא pl.; Ms. H. טפי טוּפְיָאתָא; Ms. R. טפי טופיתא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) and they (in delivering the wine) poured a liberal addition to the stipulated quantity.

verbetes.glosa_atual: [juntar, adicionar,]; colar, linha.; adicionar, juntar.; ser anexado, afixado.
definicoes_originais: to attend to, to nurse, tend.
(of lower animals) to breed, increase (v. טָפֵל).
(denom. of טָפֵל) burdened with a large family.
notas_originais: Kel. III, 4 וטְפָלָן בגללין and lined them (the cracked vessels) with a paste of ordure. Ib. 5 הטוֹפֵל וכ' if one covers with paste a sound vessel. Bets. 34 a אין טוֹפְלִין וכ' you must not cover (the fowls) with potter’s clay (to get the feathers off); Tosef. ib. III, 19 וטובלין ed. Zuck. (corr. acc.). Sabb. 80 b; Pes. 43 a; M. Kat. 9 b טוֹפְלוֹת אותן בסיד dress their skins with lime (to keep them hairless). Y. Ab. Zar. II, 40 d (in Chald. diction) שחוק וטְפוֹל grind it to powder and apply it (as a remedy); a. fr.

Ḥag. 8 a בטוֹפֵל when he combines two different funds. Ib. טוֹפְלִין בהמה לבהמה וכ' you may use the second tithe money for buying an additional animal to that designated for the pilgrim’s offering (חֲגִיגָה), but you must not join the two funds (in order to buy a larger animal). Ab. Zar. 25 b טוֹפְלוֹ לימינו lets the gentile walk to his right side, v. זָמַן; (Tosef. ib. III, 4 נותנו); Ḥull. 91 a.— Part. pass. טָפוּל a) affixed, attached. Y. Sabb. XVI, 15 c bot. (ref. to Mish. ib. 2) בשאינו ט' לו וכ' when the casing is not attached to the book, but if it is &c.—b) dependent on, supported by. Y. Dem. II, 23 a top; Y. Peah IV, 18 b bot. טְפוּלִין לאביהן dependent on (living with) their parents (cmp. B. Mets. 12 b, s. v. סָמַךְ).

Lev. R. s. 6; s. 15; Yalk. Is. 281 ונִטְפְּלוּ בישעיה and they were embodied in the Book of Isaiah. Tanḥ. Vayḥi 17 נִטְפַּלְתֶּם בעצמי you will be attached to myself (be called sons of Jacob); Yalk. Gen. 161; (Gen. R. s. 100 זכיתם בעצמי you will have a share in me).

Ḥull. 91 a ישראל שנ' וכ', v. זָמַן. Men. 65 a ניט' להם וכ' R. J. joined their discussions. Snh. 9 a הני' לעוברי עבירה he who is an accessory to sin. Y. B. Kam. X, 7 c top, שלא … נִטְפָּלִין לגנבים that citizens may not be in conspiracy with thieves (and sell the stolen goods to their owner under the pretence of having bought them).

Y. Keth. XII, 35 a top מי שני' … יִטָּפֵל בי וכ' those who attended to me (nursed me) in life, shall attend to me in death; Y. Kil. IX, 32 b top; Gen. R. s. 100; Tanḥ. Vayḥi 3. Ib, a. e. להִטָּפֵל בקבורתו to attend to his funeral; a. fr.

B. Kam. 10 b, a. e. הבעלים מִטַּפְּלִין וכ' the owner has to attend to the disposal of the carcass. B. Mets. 28 b מִטַּפֵּל בהן must take care of them. Ex. R. s. 20; Deut. R. s. 11 אני בעצמי מט' וכ' I myself shall attend to thy burial; a. fr.
Kidd. 80 a ושרצים … מִיטַּפְּלִין שם vermin and frogs breed in the house.
Taan. 16 a, sq. מט' ואין לו one having a large family with no means of support.

verbetes.glosa_atual: , para colar, gesso etc. Pes. 74 b טַפְלֵיה ההוא וכ' coloque uma pasta de massa sobre um pombo.; para ser colocado.
definicoes_originais: , to paste, plaster &c. Pes. 74 b טַפְלֵיה ההוא וכ' put a dough paste over a pigeon.
notas_originais: M. Kat. 9 b טַפְלָהּ אבר אבר put a paste on her (for improving her complexion) limb-wise; Sabb. 80 b.—Trnsf. (with שקרא) to charge falsely, calumniate (cmp. טוּחַ I, v. Ps. CXIX, 69).—Targ. Y. I Deut. I, 1.

Part. מִיטַּפַּל, מִיטַּפְלָא, מִטַּ' (not מְ') forming a scab (h. מִסְפַּחַת). Targ. Y. Lev. XIII, 6; 7; 8; 19.—2) to attend, care. Y. Taan. IV, 68 d top עד דהוון מִיטַּפְּלִין ביה while they were engaged in burying him.—3) to join, attach one’s self. Keth. 23 a אִיטְּפֵל בקריבותיך marry one of thy relations. Snh. 26 a א' בהדיהו joined them. Y. Kil. IX, 32 c bot.; Y. Keth. XII, 35 b אזל וא' בהון מן תמן (not זמן) he went and remained in their company from thence.

verbetes.glosa_atual: precedido.); anexo, de importação secundária, opp. עיקר.; por favor.
definicoes_originais: attachment, of secondary import, opp. עיקר.
notas_originais: Gen. R. s. 39 ולוט ט' לו (Var. נטפל) and Lot was merely an attachment to Abraham. Ber. 12 b ויציאת … ט' לו and the exodus from Egypt will be considered of secondary import to it (the redemption from the powers). Ib. 13 a ויעקב ט' the name Jacob will be secondary to Israel; a. fr.

טְפֵלִים, טְפֵלִין dependants, children, minors. Kidd. 34 b (ref. to Deut. XXXI, 12) ט' חייבין minors are obliged to appear; v. טַף. B. Bath. 117 a; a. fr.—Y. Shebi. VII, beg. 37 b תְּפֵילִין, v. אֲלוּנְטִית II.—V. טְפֵלָה.

Targ. O. Gen. XXXIV, 29 (Y. pl.); a. fr.— Pl. טַפְלַיָּא, טַפְלִין, טַפְלֵי. Targ. Y. Gen. XLVII, 12. Targ. Y. I Ex. XIII, 18; a. e.—Ḥull. 18 a תלו ביה ט' (Ar. טוּפְלֵי) children are dependent on him.

Targ. Jer. XLIII, 9 טְפֵיל constr. (h. text מֶלֶט).—Pes. 74 b אי מעלי טִפְלֵיה if its dough-paste is good. M. Kat. 9 b, a. e. דשתי … בעיין בנתיה ט' because he drinks beer, his daughters need paste (to improve their complexion), v. טְפַל.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (טָפַל); pasta, gesso.; apego, dependência, opp. Sim.
notas_originais: Kel. V, 7 גורר את הט' scrapes the plastering off. Ib. 8; 11. Tosef. ib. B. Kam. IV, 18; a. e.

Ber. VI, 7 כל שהוא עיקר ועמו ט' whatever food is the chief dish and something is offered to be eaten with it.—Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 27; Ex. R. s. 45, end, v. אָתַר.—Y. M. Kat. III, 82 c bot. ט' לט' (not בט') distant relations, grand-children.— Pl. טְפֵילוֹת. Y. Meg. I, 71 d bot. טְפֵילוֹתֵיהֶם their affixes (prefixes and suffixes).
, v. טְלוֹפְחָא

verbetes.glosa_atual: (cmp. טָפַף I) aderir; papel. טוֹפֵס q. v.; (cmp. טְפַז) agarrar com as mãos ou os pés, escalar.
definicoes_originais: (cmp. טָפַף I) to join; part. טוֹפֵס q. v.
(cmp. טְפַז) to seize with hands or feet, to climb.
notas_originais: Tosef. Toh. VII, 10 הרבים מִטַּפְּסִין וכ' many climb (over the fences) and walk therein. Erub. 21 a אדם מִטַּפֵּס ועולה מט' וכ' a human being may climb up and down; Y. ib. IX, beg. 25 c כמִטַּרְפֵּס וכ' (fr. טִרְפֵּס) it is as in the case of accessibility by climbing &c. B. Bath. 11 b מטפס וכ' Ms. M. a. oth. (ed. מטפיס, corr. acc., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) the chicken climbs &c. Cmp. תָּפַס.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. precedido.) [dar as mãos,] concordar, fazer um convênio.; mesmo, para ser ganho, subornado.
definicoes_originais: (v. preced.) [ to join hands,] to agree, make a covenant.
notas_originais: Targ. O. Gen. XXXIV, 15; 22; 23 (Y. אתפייס, h. text נֵאוֹת). Targ. Prov. I, 10 ed. Lag. תטפיס (ed. תתפייס); [prob. everywhere Ithpe.].
Targ. II Kings XII, 9. Targ. Is. XIII, 17, ed. Lag. (ed. מטקסין, corr. acc.).
—ט' דמלכא royal chest, treasury, archive. Yeb. 46 a; B. Mets. 73 b (Ms. M. טפט', Ms. H. a. F. ספתא, ed. Ven. טפסרא, Ar. s. v. מהרק: ספטא, ספתא, v. סִיפְטָא).
v. טוּפְסָא.—טפסין, Y. Dem. V, 24 d top, v. טָפוּס.
טפסתא, P. Sm. 1505) carpets, horse-cloths. Targ. Jer. XXXVIII, 11; sq.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Assír. dupsarru, Schr. KAT 2 pág. 424) escriba, dignitário real.
definicoes_originais: Assyr. dupsarru, Schr. KAT 2 p. 424) scribe, royal dignitary.
notas_originais: Ex. R. s. 43 (some ed. מלך as Num. R. s. 2). Gen. R. s. 90 (ref. to Jer. LI, 27) נבוכדנ' ט̇פ̇ס̇ר̇ ט̇פ̇ש … וש̇ר̇ וכ' dull as to wisdom though prince in years, v. אַבְרֵךְ.
Targ. Y. Deut. XXVIII, 12 (divine key-keeper). [B. Mets. 73 b ed. Ven., v. טַפְסָא.]— Pl. טַפְסְרַיָּא. Nah. III, 17 טַפְסְרַיִּךְ (ed. Lag. טפסרך).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (b. h.) tocar de perto, (b. h. picar); para participar, adicione. Papel.
definicoes_originais: (b. h.) to touch closely, (b. h. to mince); to join, add. Part.
notas_originais: pass. טָפוּף, f. טְפוּפָה (cmp. טְפֵי III) added to, liberally measured, contrad. to מחוק levelled, a. גדוש heaped. Men. 7 a לביסא ט' to a basin brimful, with something added on top.— Pl. טְפוּפוֹת. Yoma 48 a

Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXVIII, beg. טִיפְטְפָה דם issued drops of blood. Y. Ter. VIII, 46 a top הגשמים מְטַפְטְפִין ויורדין the rain dripped into it. Sabb. 44 a שמן המְטַפְטֵף oil dripping from the lamp.
Y. Ber. I, 3 a sq. החמה מְטַפְטֶפֶת וכ' the sun glistens on the tops of the mountains.
Targ. Job XV, 8 ואִיטַּפַּת (some ed. אַטְפֵי, h. text תגרע, v. גָּרַע II).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (טָפַף I) acréscimo aos limites da cidade, subúrbio; pr. n. por favor. Tefef.
definicoes_originais: (טָפַף I) addition to city limits, suburb; pr. n. pl. Tefef.
notas_originais: B. Bath. 75 b עתיד … אלף ט' גינואות in the future the Lord shall add to Jerusalem one thousand times the area of Tefef for gardens; Yalk. Zech. 568 (for Var. lect., v. Rabb. D. S. to B. Bath. l. c. note 40. Comment. takes טפ"ף as numerals = 169).

verbetes.glosa_atual: telha; מעשה ט' bolo assado em ladrilhos aquecidos.
definicoes_originais: tile; מעשה ט' cake baked on heated tiles.
notas_originais: Sabb. 125 a (Syr. טפקא panis tenuis in sartagine coctus, P. Sm. 1505).
, v. טוּפְרָא
Gen. R. s. 37, end (expl. סְפָר, Gen. X, 30, v. Sm. Bibl. Dict. s. v. Sephar).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (bh) estar coberto de gordura; ser inacessível, monótono, obstinado, estúpido (cmp. Lat. pinguis).; ficar monótono.; , papel. מְטוּפָּשׁ (denominação de טִפֵּשׁ) considerado um tolo, ridicularizado.
definicoes_originais: (b. h.) to be covered with fat; to be inaccessible, dull, obdurate, stupid (cmp. Lat. pinguis).
, part. מְטוּפָּשׁ (denom. of טִפֵּשׁ) decried as a fool, made sport of.
notas_originais: Ber. 63 b מִטַּפְּשִׁים they become dull; Taan. 7 a; Macc. 10 a
Sifré Deut. 309; Yalk. ib. 942 (corresp. to נבל a. לא חכם, Deut. XXXII, 6) מנוולים ומְטוּפָּשִׁים disgraced and ridiculed as fools.

verbetes.glosa_atual: tornar maçante, obstinado.; tornar-se ou ser estúpido, tolo; agir tolamente.
definicoes_originais: to become or to be dull, foolish; to act foolishly.
notas_originais: v. infra.

B. Kam. 56 a כל ט' וכ' (Ar. a. Ms. F. טַצְדְּקֵי, pl.) whatever damage there is in the power of the animal (left in the scorching sun) to do, it will do in order to get out.

VII, 3) means fully equipped, nothing wanting; Sifré Num. 45; Yalk. ib. 713; Cant. R. to VI, 4 מְטוּכָּס'; Yalk. Is. 372 מטוכ'.—V. next w. end.
